title: Lockup: Raw
description: The crew's take on being in prisons and jails across the U.S. and the world for over a decade.

title: Lockup: Holman: Extended Stay
description: Of the nearly 1,000 inmates at Holman, the 200 most dangerous must be segregated from the rest; Bobby Gilbert, or "Snake", has spent 19 of his 43 years in the solitary confinement of Ad Seg. Because of his violent behavior.

description: A surprise attack on a sheriff's deputy takes an unexpected turn, a convicted rapist loses his cool in court and an accused murderer in a high profile case tries to cash in on her notoriety.

title: Lockup: New Jersey: Extended Stay
description: A threat against an officer leads to a major shakedown; an alleged gang leader becomes a magnet for trouble; a high-speed chase ends with the discovery of a 21-year-old murder victim and now the jail must deal with her cold-blooded killer.

title: Lockup: New Jersey: Extended Stay
description: A police shootout leaves a paroled inmate in the hospital with 14 bullet wounds and two other men are arrested for their connection to him; a female inmate arrives with what she says is a hair salon mishap, but officers suspect something else.

title: Lockup: New Jersey: Extended Stay
description: A new inmate tries to adjust to life in jail, but finds himself with a target on his back and the victim of violence; a drug smuggling scheme is uncovered in the jail's mailroom and a suspect is identified.

title: Lockup: Tulsa: Extended Stay

title: Lockup: Holman: Extended Stay
